name: facts402-mcp
display_name: facts402: x402 API finder and fact checks (IBAN, VAT, sanctions, FX)
description: Find the right paid x402 API, plus fact checks: IBAN, EU VAT, OFAC sanctions, LEI, FX
long_description: Need a paid API for a task? x402_recommend ($0.005, or the free x402_recommend_preview) ranks x402 endpoints across the ecosystem by relevance, real on-chain buyers and liveness. Verified fact checks at $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base), paid from the user's own wallet within a per-call cap and session budget: IBAN/BIC validation, EU VAT (VIES), OFAC sanctions screening, GLEIF LEI company lookup, phone and email validation, ECB FX conversion, domain age (RDAP/WHOIS), business days and holidays, weather, sunrise/sunset and Base token contract facts. Each tool states its price.

x402_private_key.title: Wallet private key
x402_private_key.description: Private key of your own Base mainnet wallet holding a little USDC. Optional: without it only the free tools work.

max_per_call_usd.title: Max USD per call
max_per_call_usd.description: Most a single tool call may pay.

session_budget_usd.title: Session budget USD
session_budget_usd.description: Most the server may spend until it restarts.

tools.name: x402_recommend
tools.description: Which paid API should I call for this task? Describe the need in plain words (e.g. 'web search', 'honeypot check base token', 'IBAN validation') and get the top-k x402 endpoints across the ecosystem: url, method, price, payment network, 30-day on-chain buyers, live 402 probe, risk flags and score, ranked by relevance, real buyers, recency and liveness (x402-list.com catalog, CC BY 4.0, plus sellers' own 402 quotes). Use it before paying an unknown API. No match = 404, not charged. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 on Base, paid from your own wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY) within your per-call cap and session budget; charged only for a successful answer.

tools.name: x402_recommend_preview
tools.description: Free teaser of x402_recommend: the single top pick (host, price, 30-day payers) for a need, without url, risk flags or ranking details. FREE: no wallet or payment needed.
